description: Create ChatDrawer, ChatMode, and SpeechMode components, decomposing the monolithic VoiceChat.jsx into a slide-over drawer with Chat/Speech toggle. Depends on FEAT-001 (the new 3D Orb component).
steps: 1. Create `frontend/src/components/ChatMode.jsx` — text chat UI extracted from VoiceChat.jsx logic. Props: { messages, transcript, onSendMessage, isSending }. Renders: scrollable message list with auto-scroll (user messages right-aligned with bg-accent-purple/30 rounded-2xl rounded-br-md, AI messages left-aligned with glass class rounded-bl-md), live transcript indicator (italic, purple/20), text input + send button at bottom (same styling as current VoiceChat). The component does NOT own message state — it receives messages as a prop and calls onSendMessage(text) to send.

2. Create `frontend/src/components/SpeechMode.jsx` — full-panel orb view. Props: { voiceState, onOrbClick }. Renders: centered container with radial-gradient glow behind (bg-[radial-gradient(circle,rgba(139,92,246,0.15),transparent_70%)]), the new 3D `Orb` from components/ui/Orb.jsx (large: w-72 h-72 on desktop, w-56 h-56 on mobile via responsive classes), status label below. Map useVoice states to Orb agentState: 'idle'->null, 'listening'->'listening', 'processing'->'thinking', 'speaking'->'talking'. Dynamic colors: idle=['#8b5cf6','#a78bfa'], listening=['#a78bfa','#06b6d4'], talking=['#c084fc','#ec4899']. The orb container is clickable (button wrapping or onClick on container) calling onOrbClick. Status labels: idle='Tap to speak', listening='Listening...', processing='Thinking...', speaking='AI is speaking...'.

3. Create `frontend/src/components/ChatDrawer.jsx` — the slide-over panel. Props: { isOpen, onClose, disease, weather }. Uses framer-motion AnimatePresence + motion.div for slide-in from right (initial={{ x: '100%' }} animate={{ x: 0 }} exit={{ x: '100%' }}). Structure: dark overlay (fixed inset-0, bg-black/60, backdrop-blur-sm, onClick=onClose) + drawer panel (fixed right-0 top-0 h-full, w-full max-w-md, glass styling with bg-background-dark/95 border-l border-white/10). Inside the drawer: header with close (X) button (lucide-react X icon) and Chat/Speech toggle (two buttons, selected has bg-accent-purple/30 text-white, unselected has text-white/50). Below header: conditionally render ChatMode or SpeechMode. CRITICAL SHARED STATE: ChatDrawer owns the conversation state (messages array via useState), the useVoice hook instance, and the sendChat integration — exactly how VoiceChat.jsx currently does it. Both ChatMode and SpeechMode share the same messages array. The onTranscript callback from useVoice adds to messages and calls sendChat just like current VoiceChat.jsx does. ChatMode's onSendMessage calls the same text-send handler (also from current VoiceChat). This ensures switching between Chat and Speech preserves the full conversation.

4. Delete or gut `frontend/src/components/VoiceChat.jsx`. Since all its logic has moved to ChatDrawer/ChatMode/SpeechMode, either delete it entirely or replace with a re-export/redirect. Deleting is cleaner — AnalysisPage.jsx will import ChatDrawer instead (done in FEAT-003).
acceptance_criteria: frontend/src/components/ChatMode.jsx exists and renders message bubbles with input field
frontend/src/components/SpeechMode.jsx exists and renders the 3D Orb with state mapping and status label
frontend/src/components/ChatDrawer.jsx exists with slide-over animation, Chat/Speech toggle, shared conversation state via useVoice + sendChat

`npm run build` passes (AnalysisPage still imports VoiceChat at this point — if deleted, temporarily remove or comment the import in AnalysisPage.jsx to ensure build passes; FEAT-003 will wire ChatDrawer in)
findings: ChatMode, SpeechMode, and ChatDrawer created. ChatDrawer owns shared conversation state (messages, useVoice, sendChat). SpeechMode maps voice states to Orb agentState (idle->null, listening->'listening', processing->'thinking', speaking->'talking'). VoiceChat.jsx deleted. AnalysisPage.jsx VoiceChat import and usage removed — FEAT-003 should wire ChatDrawer in its place (import ChatDrawer, add isOpen state + toggle button, pass disease/weather props).
